entries.quote: Don’t expect Mr Biden to call off the trade war with China.
entries.subject: US-China trade war under Biden

entries.quote: Tourism will shrink and change shape, with more emphasis on domestic travel.

entries.quote: events including the Olympics, the Dubai Expo and many other political, sporting and commercial gatherings do their best to open a year later than planned. Not all will succeed.
